description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'AdhocQueryConfiguration' which sets up beans for ad hoc query services used in the Fineract project. It includes bean definitions for service implementations, with some conditional creation based on existing beans.

classes.name: AdhocQueryConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines beans for ad hoc query services related to the Fineract project, enabling dependency injection and conditional bean creation.

methods.name: adHocRowMapper
methods.description: Defines a bean for AdHocMapper, which maps query results, using a DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator.

methods.name: adHocReadPlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for AdHocReadPlatformService, providing read access to ad hoc query data, with conditional creation if not already defined.

methods.name: adHocWritePlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for AdHocWritePlatformService, providing write access to ad hoc query data, with conditional creation if not already defined.
